tools.name: fetch_media
tools.description: Get direct download links and metadata for one public post, reel, story, video or pin from Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Facebook, X (Twitter), Rutube or Likee. Returns type, download_url, thumbnail_url, width, height, duration and caption; an album returns its files in items. Credits per call: Inst

tools.name: youtube_info
tools.description: Get the title, author, duration, thumbnails and available formats with file sizes for a YouTube video or Short, or the text and media of a YouTube community post (is_post says which). Cost: 2 credits; a failed call costs 0.1.

tools.name: youtube_search
tools.description: Search YouTube videos by text. Returns video_id, title, duration and thumbnails, one page at a time. Cost: 2 credits per page; a failed call costs 0.1.

tools.name: youtube_download
tools.description: Get a direct download link for a YouTube video, as audio only or as video at a chosen height. Returns download_url, filename, duration and thumbnails. tools.name: music_charts
tools.description: Get the current Shazam top chart for a country or the whole world, paged. Returns video_id, title, duration and thumbnail_url for each song. Cost: 1 credit per page; a failed call costs 0.1.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Show the plan, remaining credits, rate limit (requests per minute) and plan expiry of the API key in use. Free.

tools.name: list_supported_platforms
tools.description: List the platforms and link forms fetch_media accepts and the credit cost of every tool. Free, and works without an API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch_media, youtube_info · Private data: fetch_media, youtube_info, get_balance, list_supported_platforms · Public sink: fetch_media, youtube_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch_media, youtube_info · Private data: fetch_media, youtube_info, get_balance, list_supported_platforms · Public sink: fetch_media, youtube_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
